title: trigonotis robusta
intro: Trigonotis robusta, commonly known as the robust trigonotis or robust trigonotis herb, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Boraginaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help alleviate respiratory issues and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
